architectureNote: APsystems uses a factory-molded 'AC Bus' (a.k.a. Y3/trunk) cable with ONE connector drop per microinverter at a FIXED interval, not a portrait/landscape pair like Enphase Q-Cable and not a separate Y-cable wired per inverter. Two families exist: the current DS3 AC Bus (10AWG, 3-wire w/ internal ground, U-1000-RO2V TC-ER, one molded connector every ~2.4m, sold MODULARLY 'per connector' so the installer sets each drop's position), and the legacy Y3 bus for YC600/QS1 (12AWG, one pre-molded connector every 2m, sold as fixed 2m/4m pieces = 1 or 2 connectors). The microinverter's own AC cable plugs into the bus drop with an audible 'click'; unused drops get a Y-CONN cap and the cut end gets a Bus End Cap. The trunk is built by chaining molded connector segments/extension cables; only the branch END is field-wired into a junction box using a field connector. Because each DS3 drop carries ~2.4m (~7.9ft) of slack, normal module spacing AND ordinary row-to-row jumps are absorbed by the drop + service loop rather than by a field splice.

terminator.rating: AC Bus End Cap - waterproofs/seals the cut END of the AC Bus trunk (DS3/QS1/QT2)

sealingCap.rating: Y-CONN / Conn Cap - protects & seals an UNUSED connector drop on the AC Bus (DS3/QS1/QT2)

extensionCable.rating: 2m, male-to-female MOLDED (plug-in, no field wiring), 12AWG, 600V, Type TC-ER, 90C/-40C. Used to bridge gaps between microinverters greater than ~6ft (large row-to-row jumps/obstructions)

spliceInstallRule.realRule: The AC Bus is a factory-molded continuous trunk with one connector drop per microinverter at a fixed interval (DS3 ~2.4m/7.9ft, Y3 2m/6.6ft). Microinverters plug into molded drops (audible click) - NO field wiring. The generous ~2.4m per-connector DS3 drop plus service loop absorbs both module spacing and ordinary row-to-row jumps, so a row transition does NOT require a field splice. Field-wired connections occur ONLY where the bus terminates into a junction box / grid connection - typically ONE field connector (male 2300931202) per branch circuit. Larger gaps are bridged with plug-in molded AC extension cables (AC-EXT-1/2/4), which are also NOT field-wired. Therefore 'field splices' do NOT equal 'row transitions' and counting 1 per row transition overcounts.
spliceInstallRule.source: APsystems DS3 Series Installation/User Manual (global.apsystems.com, Rev1.5 2025-03) + DS3 Quick Install Guide Rev4.0 2024-01 + distributor listings, retrieved 2026-07. Field-wired connection count is ~1 per branch (junction-box termination), not per row; the only field-wireable part is the end connector.

caveats: SKU CONFLICT / FIELD-VERIFY: distributors report the End Cap and the Y-CONN/Conn Cap part numbers inconsistently (2060700017 vs 2060700007 appear swapped across powerstore/hdmsolar/stellavolta/shopsolarkits). Confirm exact PNs against an APsystems price list before ordering.

DS3 AC Bus 'APS-221-115' is a Solacity distributor SKU; the APsystems manufacturer part number for the 10AWG DS3 AC Bus was not definitively captured (BayWa/SolarOnline list it generically as 'DS3/DS3-L AC Trunk Cable'). FIELD-VERIFY mfr PN and per-connector length option.
Female field connector 2300932202 is listed at 32A and the male 2300931202 at 40A/600V; verify current derating for a 20A branch and that both are field-wireable for the US 10AWG split-phase bus.
Prices are distributor listings (2026, mixed USD/CAD); cable priceUsdPerFt values are DERIVED from per-connector / per-length listings (DS3 ~$49 per 2.4m connector; Y3 ~$38 per 4m).

maxDevicesPerBranch is MODEL-SPECIFIC on a 20A/240V split-phase branch: DS3 = 4, DS3-S = 5, DS3-L = 6 (value 4 = flagship DS3). A 30A branch permits up to 6 DS3. Legacy QS1/YC600 counts differ - confirm per the active microinverter's datasheet appendix.

APsystems has NO portrait-vs-landscape cable variants like Enphase Q-Cable; spacing is fixed per cable family. The DS3 bus is modular 'per connector' so the installer positions each drop, which is the closest analog to Enphase's spacing choice.

The Y3 12AWG cable is the legacy YC600/QS1 bus and appears in older docs referenced even for DS3 install steps ('Y3 AC trunk cable'); current US DS3 installs use the 10AWG bus. Treat the two cable entries as generation variants, not simultaneous options.
